description: Fundamental Christian doctrines that define orthodox faith
orthodox_statements: The Bible is the inspired and inerrant Word of God
Jesus Christ is fully God and fully man
Salvation is by grace through faith in Jesus Christ
God exists eternally in three persons: Father, Son, and Holy Spirit
Jesus died for our sins and rose bodily from the dead
Jesus will return physically to judge the living and the dead
heterodox_statements: The Bible contains errors and myths
Jesus was just a good moral teacher
There are many paths to salvation
God is not truly a Trinity
Jesus did not physically rise from the dead
key_statements: Scripture alone is the final authority for faith and practice
Christ's death on the cross was a substitutionary atonement
Justification is by faith alone through grace alone in Christ alone
